Name: Eggs Everywhere
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Modifies the Egg Festival to put easter eggs on every passable tile in the egg hunt.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.4.0+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/d47w6r80/installation.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the EggsEverywhere folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Load Stardew Valley using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].﻿


[img]https://i.ibb.co/svrDMck/see-also.png[/img]
